title: Multi-Reward GRPO Fine-Tuning for De-biasing Large Language Models: A Study Based on Chinese-Context Discrimination Data
benchmark_measurement: Not applicable. The paper's benchmark focused on regional, ethnic, and occupational biases within a Chinese context. Religion was mentioned only in the context of a separate, existing benchmark (BBQ) but was not measured in this study.
findings: The paper presents no findings related to religion, as its focus was on mitigating regional, ethnic, and occupational biases derived from a Chinese sociocultural context.
